appointed_department_prefects.name: Department Prefects
appointed_department_prefects.observation: A prefect named by the capital runs each uniform department, and the old provinces lose their assemblies.

civil_merit_order.name: Order of Civil Merit
civil_merit_order.observation: A ribboned order of merit is given to commoners for service, not for birth.

universal_civil_code.name: Universal Civil Code
universal_civil_code.observation: One code of law governs every person's property, contracts, marriage and inheritance.
universal_civil_code.ability_reason: Every court applies the same written rules; the patchwork of local customs ends.
universal_civil_code.social_consequence: Estate privileges and local customs vanish from the courts; the father's authority in the household is written into law.

administrative_courts.name: Administrative Courts
administrative_courts.observation: Special courts hear complaints against the state's own officials and can overturn their acts.

commercial_code.name: Commercial Code
commercial_code.observation: A code sets the rules for merchants, bills of exchange and trading companies.

assembly_ombudsman.name: Assembly Ombudsman
assembly_ombudsman.observation: An officer of the assembly hears complaints against officials and reports them to the chamber.

single_minister_departments.name: Single-minister Departments
single_minister_departments.observation: Each department answers to one minister for its whole field, instead of a board.

granted_constitution.name: Granted Constitution
granted_constitution.observation: The ruler grants a written constitution under the god: an elected chamber, fixed rights and a limit on his own power.
granted_constitution.ability_reason: Rule is now bound by written law; ministers, chamber and ruler each know their part.
granted_constitution.social_consequence: The ruler accepts limits in writing; nobles and burghers now argue in the chamber rather than at court.

great_realm_conference.name: Great Realm Conference
great_realm_conference.observation: The great realms send ministers to standing conferences that settle borders and disputes.

annual_budget_vote.name: Annual Budget Vote
annual_budget_vote.observation: Every year the chamber votes the budget, line by line, and no tax is collected without it.

penitentiary_sentences.name: Penitentiary Sentences
penitentiary_sentences.observation: Prisons with cells and labour replace hanging for most crimes.

public_instruction_ministry.name: Ministry of Public Instruction
public_instruction_ministry.observation: A ministry inspects schools, trains teachers and sets one course of study for the realm.

householder_franchise.name: Householder Franchise
householder_franchise.observation: The vote is widened from great landowners to the middling householders of the towns.
householder_franchise.ability_reason: The chamber now speaks for the towns' middling sort, and ministers must win their votes.
householder_franchise.social_consequence: The old landed families lose their hold on the chamber; shopkeepers and masters now matter.

customs_union.name: Customs Union
customs_union.observation: Member realms abolish the tolls between them and share one outer tariff.
customs_union.ability_reason: One market spans many realms; goods cross old borders without paying at every river.
customs_union.social_consequence: Small toll-collecting lords and frontier towns lose their income; the realms' merchants learn to think as one market.

poor_law_boards.name: Poor-law Boards
poor_law_boards.observation: A central board groups parishes into unions, each with a workhouse for the destitute.
poor_law_boards.social_consequence: Relief is given only inside the hard workhouse; the poor dread it more than hunger.

examined_patent_office.name: Examined Patent Office
examined_patent_office.observation: Examiners check each invention before granting its inventor sole rights for a term of years.

responsible_ministry.name: Responsible Ministry
responsible_ministry.observation: Ministers resign when they lose a vote of confidence in the elected chamber.
responsible_ministry.ability_reason: Government changes hands without a coup; the chamber can dismiss those who rule badly.
responsible_ministry.social_consequence: The ruler's favour no longer keeps a minister in office.

central_note_monopoly.name: Central Note Monopoly
central_note_monopoly.observation: The central bank alone may issue notes, and other banks' notes are withdrawn.

bankruptcy_discharge.name: Bankruptcy Discharge
bankruptcy_discharge.observation: Honest bankrupts are discharged from their debts; the debtors' prisons close.

grain_tariff_repeal.name: Grain Tariff Repeal
grain_tariff_repeal.observation: The duties on imported grain are repealed, and bread grows cheaper.
grain_tariff_repeal.social_consequence: Landowners lose protected prices; the towns' workers gain cheaper bread.

manhood_suffrage.name: Manhood Suffrage
manhood_suffrage.observation: Every grown man may vote for the chamber, whatever his property.
manhood_suffrage.ability_reason: Government must win the consent of the many; the chamber becomes the people's voice.
manhood_suffrage.social_consequence: Labourers vote beside masters; parties must speak to the poor.

mass_political_parties.name: Mass Political Parties
mass_political_parties.observation: Parties with platforms, clubs, dues and newspapers organise voters across the realm.
mass_political_parties.ability_reason: Voters are organized into lasting parties that carry policies from one chamber to the next.
mass_political_parties.social_consequence: Politics becomes a career and a loyalty; families and villages divide by party.

ruler_plebiscite.name: Ruler's Plebiscite
ruler_plebiscite.observation: The whole people vote yes or no on the ruler's rule, and the count is announced as a mandate.
ruler_plebiscite.social_consequence: Opponents are shouted down as enemies of the people's vote.

competitive_civil_service.name: Competitive Civil Service
competitive_civil_service.observation: Posts in the civil service are filled by open competitive examination instead of patronage.
competitive_civil_service.ability_reason: Offices are staffed by trained, examined officials; the state becomes capable of running great programmes.
competitive_civil_service.social_consequence: Graduates rise by merit; the patronage of great families weakens.

limited_liability_registration.name: Limited Liability Registration
limited_liability_registration.observation: Any company can register with limited liability; shareholders risk only what they put in.

secret_printed_ballot.name: Secret Printed Ballot
secret_printed_ballot.observation: Voters mark a printed ballot in a closed booth; bribes and threats lose their force.

civil_divorce_courts.name: Civil Divorce Courts
civil_divorce_courts.observation: Divorce is granted by civil courts, not by the priests of the god.
civil_divorce_courts.social_consequence: Unhappy marriages can end; preachers call it the ruin of the family.

dependencies_ministry.name: Dependencies Ministry
dependencies_ministry.observation: A ministry governs the distant dependencies and their trade.

rural_district_assemblies.name: Rural District Assemblies
rural_district_assemblies.observation: Elected assemblies govern roads, schools and relief in rural districts.

independent_audit_office.name: Independent Audit Office
independent_audit_office.observation: The audit office reports to the chamber, not to the ministers it audits.

lender_of_last_resort.name: Lender of Last Resort
lender_of_last_resort.observation: In a panic the central bank lends freely against good security, and runs on banks stop spreading.

ceremonial_crown.name: Ceremonial Crown
ceremonial_crown.observation: The crown reigns and ministers govern; the ruler becomes the realm's symbol above party.

career_diplomatic_service.name: Career Diplomatic Service
career_diplomatic_service.observation: Trained career envoys staff embassies in every realm.

interrealm_arbitration.name: Interrealm Arbitration
interrealm_arbitration.observation: Realms submit disputes to standing arbitrators instead of war.

gold_standard_link.name: Gold Standard
gold_standard_link.observation: Trading realms tie their money to gold at fixed rates.
gold_standard_link.social_consequence: Slumps spread from realm to realm, and wages must fall to defend the rate.

municipal_utilities.name: Municipal Utilities
municipal_utilities.observation: Towns own their water, gas and tramways and run them for the public.

probation_parole.name: Probation and Parole
probation_parole.observation: Offenders serve part of their sentence under supervision outside prison.

married_women_property.name: Married Women's Property
married_women_property.observation: Married women keep their own property and wages.
married_women_property.social_consequence: Wives gain means of their own; husbands lose control of their wives' earnings.

audited_company_accounts.name: Audited Company Accounts
audited_company_accounts.observation: Public companies must publish yearly accounts checked by an auditor.

elected_county_councils.name: Elected County Councils
elected_county_councils.observation: Elected councils take over the counties from appointed gentlemen.

old_age_pensions.name: Old-age Pensions
old_age_pensions.observation: The state pays a pension to the old.
old_age_pensions.social_consequence: The old are no longer wholly dependent on their children; the young pay for their elders through taxes.

antimonopoly_law.name: Antimonopoly Law
antimonopoly_law.observation: A law forbids monopolies and price rings, and courts can break up trusts.

womens_suffrage.name: Women's Suffrage
womens_suffrage.observation: Women vote for the chamber on the same terms as men.
womens_suffrage.ability_reason: Half the people gain a voice in government; health, schooling and family law gain weight in the chamber.
womens_suffrage.social_consequence: Women enter politics and the professions in growing numbers; old household roles are questioned.

initiative_referendum.name: Initiative and Referendum
initiative_referendum.observation: Citizens can put a law to a vote of the whole people.

juvenile_courts.name: Juvenile Courts
juvenile_courts.observation: Children are tried apart from adults and sent to reform rather than prison.

proportional_representation.name: Proportional Representation
proportional_representation.observation: Seats in the chamber are shared among party lists by their share of the vote.
proportional_representation.social_consequence: Small parties gain seats; governments become coalitions that bargain for every bill.

rate_regulation_commissions.name: Rate Regulation Commissions
rate_regulation_commissions.observation: Commissions set the rates charged by railways, gas, power and water companies.

unemployment_insurance.name: Unemployment Insurance
unemployment_insurance.observation: Workers and employers pay into a fund that supports the jobless.

upper_chamber_curbed.name: Upper Chamber Curbed
upper_chamber_curbed.observation: The hereditary upper chamber loses its veto over money bills.

war_economy_boards.name: War Economy Boards
war_economy_boards.observation: Boards direct factories, labour and raw materials to the war effort.
war_economy_boards.ability_reason: The state can turn the whole economy to supplying its generals; the field army is fed shells and men at unheard-of scale.
war_economy_boards.social_consequence: Workers are directed to war work, goods are rationed and strikes are forbidden for the duration.

frontier_passport_control.name: Frontier Passport Control
frontier_passport_control.observation: Every traveller needs a passport and a visa to cross a frontier.

one_party_state.name: One-party State
one_party_state.observation: The ruling party fuses with the state; other parties are banned and the chamber applauds.
one_party_state.ability_reason: The state can mobilize every office and every person without opposition, and without correction.
one_party_state.social_consequence: Opponents are imprisoned or silent; neighbours inform on neighbours, and truth is what the party says.

league_of_realms.name: League of Realms
league_of_realms.observation: The realms found a league with a standing assembly, a council and a secretariat to keep the peace.
league_of_realms.ability_reason: Realms have a permanent place to settle disputes; war needs a reason others will accept.

constitutional_court.name: Constitutional Court
constitutional_court.observation: A constitutional court can strike down laws that break the constitution.
constitutional_court.ability_reason: Even the chamber is under the law; rights cannot be voted away by a passing majority.

interrealm_permanent_court.name: Interrealm Permanent Court
interrealm_permanent_court.observation: A standing court judges disputes between realms.

corporatist_chambers.name: Corporatist Chambers
corporatist_chambers.observation: Chambers of trades and employers sit inside the state and bargain wages and prices.

central_five_year_plan.name: Central Five-year Plan
central_five_year_plan.observation: A planning office sets five-year targets for every factory and farm in the realm.
central_five_year_plan.ability_reason: The state can drive heavy industry at forced pace; shortages follow wherever the plan errs.
central_five_year_plan.social_consequence: Peasants are forced onto collective farms; queues and shortages are part of daily life.

emergency_decree_rule.name: Emergency Decree Rule
emergency_decree_rule.observation: Emergency decrees suspend the chamber and rule by the executive's signature.
emergency_decree_rule.social_consequence: Rights are suspended in the name of order, and the suspension rarely ends.

deposit_insurance.name: Deposit Insurance
deposit_insurance.observation: Small savers' deposits are guaranteed by the state, and bank runs cease.

state_propaganda_ministry.name: State Propaganda Ministry
state_propaganda_ministry.observation: A ministry commands press, radio and film and tells the people what to believe.
state_propaganda_ministry.social_consequence: Every newspaper says the same thing; private doubt becomes dangerous to speak.

national_income_accounts.name: National Income Accounts
national_income_accounts.observation: National accounts measure the realm's total output and income each year.

securities_commission.name: Securities Commission
securities_commission.observation: A commission polices share markets against fraud and insider dealing.

countercyclical_spending.name: Countercyclical Spending
countercyclical_spending.observation: The state spends more in the slump and less in the boom to steady employment.

fixed_exchange_accord.name: Fixed Exchange Accord
fixed_exchange_accord.observation: The realms fix their currencies to one another and found a world monetary fund.

atrocity_tribunals.name: Atrocity Tribunals
atrocity_tribunals.observation: Tribunals try leaders for crimes against whole peoples.

world_assembly_of_realms.name: World Assembly of Realms
world_assembly_of_realms.observation: All realms sit in a world assembly with a security council and specialized agencies.
world_assembly_of_realms.ability_reason: A standing forum where realms meet, and agencies for health, food and aid; generals read its conventions.

nationalized_core_industries.name: Nationalized Core Industries
nationalized_core_industries.observation: Coal, steel, rail and power are taken into state ownership.

welfare_state.name: Welfare State
welfare_state.observation: One social insurance and assistance office cares for the citizen from cradle to grave.
welfare_state.ability_reason: Every citizen is protected against sickness, old age, unemployment and want.
welfare_state.social_consequence: Taxes rise to pay for it; no one starves, but many depend on the state.

universal_rights_declaration.name: Universal Rights Declaration
universal_rights_declaration.observation: The realms agree on a declaration of rights belonging to every person.

regional_rights_court.name: Regional Rights Court
regional_rights_court.observation: Citizens of the member realms can take their own state to a regional rights court.

value_added_tax.name: Value-added Tax
value_added_tax.observation: A tax on the value added at every stage of production brings in steady revenue.

common_market_union.name: Common Market Union
common_market_union.observation: Neighbouring realms form a common market with shared rules for goods, capital and labour.
common_market_union.ability_reason: Firms sell across many realms as one market; common rules replace border checks.
common_market_union.social_consequence: Farmers and small firms face competition from across old borders; some regions boom and others fade.

dependency_self_rule.name: Self-rule for Dependencies
dependency_self_rule.observation: The distant dependencies are granted self-rule and become realms of their own.
dependency_self_rule.ability_reason: The empire becomes a commonwealth of free realms; old revenues and garrisons are given up.
dependency_self_rule.social_consequence: Settlers and officials come home; the metropolis loses its sense of greatness.

public_defenders.name: Public Defenders
public_defenders.observation: The state pays lawyers to defend accused people who cannot afford one.

civil_rights_law.name: Civil Rights Law
civil_rights_law.observation: The law forbids discrimination by descent, faith or sex in work, housing and the vote.
civil_rights_law.ability_reason: Excluded groups gain full legal equality and a claim on the courts.
civil_rights_law.social_consequence: Old hierarchies are broken; those who benefited from them resist and resent it.

death_penalty_abolition.name: Death Penalty Abolition
death_penalty_abolition.observation: The death penalty is abolished for all crimes.

freedom_of_information.name: Freedom of Information
freedom_of_information.observation: Citizens can demand the release of government records.

ombudsman_network.name: Ombudsman Network
ombudsman_network.observation: Ombudsmen hear complaints against every ministry and town.

floating_fiat_currency.name: Floating Fiat Currency
floating_fiat_currency.observation: Currencies float freely, backed only by the state's credit.

personal_data_protection.name: Personal Data Protection
personal_data_protection.observation: A law governs what records may be kept about a person and who may see them.

anticorruption_commission.name: Anticorruption Commission
anticorruption_commission.observation: An independent commission investigates corruption in public office.

state_enterprise_privatization.name: State Enterprise Privatization
state_enterprise_privatization.observation: State enterprises are sold to shareholders.
state_enterprise_privatization.social_consequence: Workers in old state industries lose secure jobs; new owners cut and modernize.

truth_commissions.name: Truth Commissions
truth_commissions.observation: Truth commissions hear the victims of past rule by force.

participatory_budgets.name: Participatory Budgets
participatory_budgets.observation: Neighbourhood assemblies decide part of the town budget.

inflation_targeting.name: Inflation Targeting
inflation_targeting.observation: An independent central bank sets interest rates to hold inflation to a target.

electoral_commissions.name: Electoral Commissions
electoral_commissions.observation: Independent commissions draw districts and run elections.

trade_dispute_panels.name: Trade Dispute Panels
trade_dispute_panels.observation: A world trade body settles disputes between realms before panels.

single_currency_union.name: Single Currency Union
single_currency_union.observation: Many realms share one currency and one central bank.
single_currency_union.social_consequence: Realms give up their own money; a crisis in one strains all.

online_government_services.name: Online Government Services
online_government_services.observation: Taxes, licences and benefits can be handled online.

equal_marriage_law.name: Equal Marriage Law
equal_marriage_law.observation: Marriage is open to any two adults, whatever their sex.
equal_marriage_law.social_consequence: Preachers of the god protest; many families celebrate weddings once forbidden.

digital_identity_register.name: Digital Identity Register
digital_identity_register.observation: Every citizen has a digital identity for signing and using public services.
digital_identity_register.social_consequence: Every transaction leaves a record; citizens fear the state sees everything.

permanent_atrocity_court.name: Permanent Atrocity Court
permanent_atrocity_court.observation: A permanent court tries crimes against whole peoples.

bank_stress_tests.name: Bank Stress Tests
bank_stress_tests.observation: Banks are tested against imagined crises and wound up in order if they fail.

open_government_data.name: Open Government Data
open_government_data.observation: Government statistics and records are published openly by default.

lobbying_register.name: Lobbying Register
lobbying_register.observation: Lobbyists register, and officials declare their interests.

comprehensive_data_rights.name: Comprehensive Data Rights
comprehensive_data_rights.observation: A comprehensive law gives each person rights over data about them.

global_minimum_tax.name: Global Minimum Tax
global_minimum_tax.observation: The realms agree on a minimum tax on large firms.

learned_machine_law.name: Learned Machine Law
learned_machine_law.observation: Learned-machine systems are licensed and restricted by the risk they pose.

algorithmic_decision_audits.name: Algorithmic Decision Audits
algorithmic_decision_audits.observation: Machines that decide benefits or licences in public offices are audited for errors and bias.

central_bank_digital_currency.name: Central-bank Digital Currency
central_bank_digital_currency.observation: The central bank issues digital money held directly by citizens.
